app.name: OKR Planner

home.title: Quarterly OKR plans
home.subtitle: Enter your OKRs, answer a few clarifying questions, and get tasks plus a weekly calendar that fits your hours.
home.emptyBody: Start by picking a quarter, then enter Objectives and Key Results.

ai.noFallbackTitle: No automatic switch to another provider

paste.title: Describe your OKRs
paste.placeholder:
O1: Pass the B2 English exam

KR1: Enrol in a course around 20/10
KR2: Study every day from 20/10 to 8/12, no missed sessions
KR3: Take at least 6 mock tests, the last 3 at B2 level or above
KR4: Pass the B2 exam around 8/12
paste.hint: Type or paste one or more OKRs, then press "Fill in below": AI turns them into Objectives and Key Results (type, target, due date) as cards. The box clears so you can add the next OKR. Cards stay editable; use the trash icon on a card to delete an OKR.
